QuestInfo.name: Hughes Needs the Eraser
QuestInfo.0: Hughes seems to be in need of help. I better go see him.
QuestInfo.1: Hughes has been trying to go on with his research, but told me he needs an eraser to continue...
QuestInfo.2: I got Hughes the eraser he's been seeking.

0.0: How did you find your way here? As you can see, I am busy researching... but I have run into a problem, and my research has hit a dead end.
0.1: When I'm conducting studies and researching, I go through a lot of pencils for maps, blueprints, equations, etc.. This also creates enough mess to erase, but alas, I have used up all my erasers... this is the reason why I can't erase my mistakes...
0.2: This is exactly the reason why I need an eraser... so if you have one, can you give one to me?

yes.0: Good choice. You don't need to carry that around if you don't put that to good use... and since I will be conducting studies inside, I hardly ever have time to go outside and get one myself.
yes.1: Hey you have a variety of erasers. Just give me one each of #b#t4001038#, #t4001039#, #t4001040#, #t4001041#, #t4001042#, or #t4001043##k. Let me know when you're ready to go on.

no.0: You hardly ever use erasers... in that case, leave my lab immediately! You're nothing but a distraction! *grumbles*

1.0: Thank you so much. I'll put these erasers to good use. Thank you!

yes.0: I have to reward you for this... but this is all I have right now. I found this around the lab the other day.

item.0: Check it once more! Are you sure you have the erasers ready to give?
